title: Animal camouflage
examples: Why do some animals change their color?
What is camouflage used for in the wild?
Can animals really hide from people?

explain.say: Look at this picture. The animal looks like it is part of the leaves.
This trick helps animals stay hidden from others.
Some animals use stripes to break up their shape.
Spots help animals match the pattern on the ground.
Chameleons can change their skin color to hide better.
When you are walking in the grass, you can use camouflage too.

faq.q: Why do animals need to hide?
faq.a: They hide to stay safe from bigger animals or to sneak up on food.
asks: What is the purpose of camouflage?

faq.a: No, some animals use other ways to stay safe, like making loud noises.
asks: What if an animal cannot blend in?

faq.q: Can chameleons change color all the time?
faq.a: They can change color to match their surroundings or to show feelings.
asks: Is color change only for hiding?

faq.a: Sometimes stripes can also help animals look strong or warn others away.
asks: What else can stripes do for an animal?

faq.q: Is blending in the same as camouflage?
faq.a: Yes, blending in is one way that camouflage helps an animal stay hidden.
asks: What is the link between blending and camouflage?
Are these two words the same thing?

facts: Camouflage helps animals avoid being seen by predators.
Stripes and spots help break up the animal's outline.
Chameleons are famous for changing their skin color.
Animals use camouflage for both hiding and surprising others.

quiz.say: A zebra's stripes help it confuse hunters by:

options.show: Making it hard to see the animal's shape.
options.say: Making it hard to see the animal's shape.

options.show: Making it look like a forest
options.say: Making it look like a forest

quiz.why: The stripes confuse the eye, making the animal look like many pieces.

wrong.0: The pattern itself confuses, not the speed.
wrong.2: The stripes are black and white, not like leaves.
wrong.3: Camouflage is about sight, not smell.

quiz.say: If an animal lives near brown dirt, what pattern might help it blend in?
quiz.why: Spots help the animal match the texture and color of the dirt.

wrong.0: Shiny metal reflects light too much to hide.
wrong.2: Blue stripes would stand out very much against brown dirt.
wrong.3: Green leaves belong in a plant area, not on the dirt.

quiz.say: Which animal is most known for changing its skin color?
quiz.why: Chameleons are famous for their ability to change skin color.

wrong.0: Tigers use stripes, but they do not change color like this.
wrong.1: Zebras have fixed black and white stripes.
wrong.2: Giraffes have fixed brown spots, but they cannot change them.
